text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—Palmer, thanks a ton for yesterday! See 
ya!!
choice_data_list:
Looks like you managed to get a little 
breather.

Looks like you managed to get a little 
breather, huh?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you. Palmer invited me to 
karaoke since we're roommates, but you 
see――

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Both she and her bestie Helios are, like, 
party-animal hype masters, y'know? They're 
so crazy good at getting the crowd going!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, all that energy from them blew my 
fatigue right away!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Katsuragi Ace thoroughly enjoyed 
her day off.
